description:
Remove Kaleido, Pandas, and Pillow from visualization dependencies, keeping only Plotly.

**Motivation:**
- Pandas is NOT used in any visualization code (0 imports) but adds ~50MB and 4 transitive deps
- Pillow is NOT used in any visualization code
- Kaleido requires Chrome/Chromium binary, causing installation issues in containers/CI
- Simplifies installation and reduces dependency footprint

**Trade-off:**
- Loses static image export (PNG, SVG, PDF) - only HTML export remains
- HTML exports include full Plotly.js (~2-5MB per file) but work everywhere
- Users needing static images can screenshot or use browser print-to-PDF

**Evidence from codebase analysis:**
- `benchbox/core/visualization/` has 0 pandas imports
- `benchbox/core/visualization/` has 0 pillow imports
- Kaleido only used in `exporters.py:71-72` for `pio.write_image()`
